* '''PC-E1''' ([[Tonnika Sisters (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 22 release sheet<ref name="sheet22-20231006">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2023”; file created 6 October 2023).
